snippet.title: SIRENS: Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Platform:  PC   Release date: TBA
Wishlist: store.steampowered.com/app/2541950/Sirens/

Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swum in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

How long will you survive in a sea full of bloodthirsty sharks? Will you capture a Spinosaurus and fend off the tentacles of the Kraken? Or perhaps you dream of a Megalodon tooth? Don't look for it in a museum, snatch it from the jaws yourself!


MAIN FEATURES

- Exploration of sea and ocean waters
- Survival mode
- Main Hub customization
- Mermaid customization
- Combat using melee weapons
- Boss battles
